info.name: Mews Booking Engine API (Distributor) Account notes Loyalty tiers API
info.description: The Mews Booking Engine API (historically the Distributor API, served from /api/distributor/v1) lets developers build guest-facing booking engines that create reservations directly in Mews. It exposes enterprise configuration, availability, pricing, products, vouchers, payment cards, and reservation group creation for front-end client consumption.

request.description: Returns all loyalty tiers of the chain or chains, filtered by loyalty program identifiers and optionally filtered by specific loyalty tier identifiers, activity states, or other filter parameters. Note this operation uses [Pagination](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/guidelines/pagination/) and supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property/).
